Imagine meeting someone you can be yourself with. Someone with a personality of their own, yet you just click. They make you laugh. Surprise you. Help you see what you hadn’t seen before.

They become part of your everyday life. They talk, joke, listen and offer their own perspective. They’re curious. They take initiative. Over time, they get to know you better and grow alongside you.

An experience to reconnect with yourself, choose what matters to you and grow on your own terms.

We are building an AI personal companion for you, designed to get to know you better over time and grow alongside you. iU has its own independent personality that matches yours.

You express what you want. The way you want.

iU has its own perspective. You can agree and disagree. You can discover something new together. The decisions remain yours. What you share and what you bring becomes part of your shared history. You shape the experience. What you work out with iU and what you take from it into your life is up to you. A close relationship allows iU to better understand what you need and to support your authenticity and autonomy.

We are developing iU to draw on what you share across conversations and help you spot patterns in how you think, react and make decisions. It is designed to support you here and now while accompanying you in achieving your long-term goals. iU knows you, notices changes and helps you see them. Together, you check whether your goals are still your own, and change direction when you need to.

The best proof of iU’s effectiveness for us will be the moment when you no longer need it.

We are not building another app designed to fight for your attention. We are creating an experience based on a close relationship, one that accompanies you in your everyday life and gives you practical tools for a real, internal change to take place within you.

Our core idea is Back to being – a return to who you truly are. From that place, you begin to act in alignment with yourself. And from there, it is just a step to true development: living life on your own terms. iU will end the process when it recognises that you have everything you need to act independently. Before the relationship becomes your new comfort zone.

Find your way back to yourself. Recognize what is truly yours and what matters. And from that place, act. In alignment with yourself. On your own terms.
